Here is the first single soulful melody "Sees Gang" video song from the classical album "Karuna Nidhaan". Sung by Abhradita Banerjee. Music produced by Charu Hariharan.
Sees Gang is the true confluence of devotion and poetry where Maharaja Swathi Thirunal describes the beauty and alluring characteristics of Lord Shiva. He also mentions that Lord Shiva resides in the heart of Lord Padmanabha.
Credits::
Track: Sees Gang
Composed and Sung by - Abhradita Banerjee
Lyrics - Maharaja Swathi Thirunal
Arranged and Produced by - Charu Hariharan
Flute - Vishnu Vijay
